bias.label: Leaning down below 3,770; 3,750 support has broken

event: FOMC minutes tonight, Wed 18 Nov, at 21:00 SAST. Next Fed decision 8-9 Dec.

bullets.title: New low today
bullets.text: Spot gold is about 3,744, down about 2.7% on the day, after breaking the 3,750-3,770 support from this morning (spot quote time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Futures low 3,741
bullets.text: December COMEX futures hit a session low of 3,740.80 and traded at 3,746 at 18:27 SAST, down about 3.1%.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Odds of a December quarter-point Fed hike are about 95-97%, with a small chance of a half-point move.

bullets.title: Dollar still firm
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 103.8-103.9, near a 19-month high, while the 10-year yield eased to about 5.06-5.07%.

bullets.title: Big weekly drop
bullets.text: Gold is down about 8.6% in a week and is at its lowest since September 2025, so bounces can be sharp.

bullets.title: Minutes at 21:00
bullets.text: The October FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast either way, so stand aside around them.

levels.note: FXEmpire support from this morning and earlier low, now overhead

Session low 3,740.80 on December futures (futures, not spot)

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,680-3,700 (counter-trend)
look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price dipping into 3,680-3,700 and holding, not slicing through.
A 15M close back above 3,700 after the dip.
The dollar easing from about 103.9 after the minutes.
Take some profit at 3,730 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Catching a falling knife. Do not buy at 3,740 just because it fell a lot; wait for the zone and a hold.
Hawkish FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can break support fast. Do not enter in the 15 minutes before or after.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,760-3,770
look: Price bouncing back up into 3,760-3,770 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close back under 3,760.
Take some profit at 3,730 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,744 near the day's low after a 2.7% drop. That is chasing; wait for a bounce into 3,760-3,770.
The FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can spike price either way. Do not enter in the 15 minutes before or after.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
